overall.summary: CP2 Autogen-scoped Site Forge layout recognizably matches hairpins, long straights, parallel lanes, and curve continuity. The red-boxed concentric spiral maps to the P600/P700 curve bank (same IO word as Autogen, not PE/VFD-linked). A generic same-IO-word dense CURVE-bank display-context expansion now places that bank on the canvas without changing PLC ownership (35 owned).

regions.print_feature: Red-boxed concentric circular/spiral conveyor assembly (multi-loop curves with radial feeders)
regions.reason: Spiral-area analysis maps this assembly to P600/P602/P610/P612/P700/… families. Initially missing from Autogen graph (not PE/VFD-linked) despite sharing IO_Address_Word=6000. Generic same-IO-word dense CURVE-bank display-context expansion now places the bank (~53 spiral-family tags, dashed displayContext). Arrangement is recognizable as a multi-CURVE field; print sheet framing/spacing remain schematic.
regions.fix_applied: Same-IO-word dense CURVE arc-center cluster (≥5, radius 5000u) + endpoint mates as display_context when mostly outside Autogen ownership.

regions.print_feature: U-turn / hairpin corridor near mid-right of main conveyor band (paired with east hairpin)
regions.reason: Pass2 display-context completed P126→P128→P130→P132→P134 with SVG arcs; P136/P136A share entry with P134 (SAME_PHYSICAL_ASSEMBLY). Curve continuity and L/J shape are recognizable vs print hairpin vocabulary.

regions.print_feature: Second hairpin / return curve pair on parallel corridor
regions.reason: P142→P144→P145→P146→P148 complete with arcs; P150/P150A shared-entry ZP. Recognizable as twin of west hairpin.

regions.print_feature: Long horizontal and vertical conveyor runs across the print
regions.reason: Infeed-origin straights render with correct direction and relative length scaling. Absolute plant framing differs from print sheet crop/rotation; some long plant runs (e.g. distant P230/P232 cluster) appear as outliers on the canvas because Autogen scope is sparse there.

PARALLEL_CONVEYOR classification applies presentation lane separation only to true parallels; serial/same-assembly stay joined. Parallel banks (e.g. P1000-series verticals) are readable as separate lanes but spacing is schematic, not print-scaled.

regions.print_feature: CURVE bodies as arcs rather than rectangles
regions.reason: CURVE equipment uses Inside_Radius + tangents + SVG A arcs; stroke scaled for readability. Field b remains mate-scored hypothesis (MEDIUM), not blind truth.

ORNCCP2 Autogen Auto Build reports merges_detected=0 for the scoped set. Merge fan presentation exists in UI when asMerge + inbound wires are present; not exercised by current CP2 Autogen geometric graph. Not scored as WRONG_GEOMETRY.

regions.print_feature: Readable equipment IDs without Area/ES wallpaper
regions.reason: Canvas defaults to P-tag only; Area/ES remain inspector-only; missing config is a small warn dot. Meets acceptance for demo readability.
